rundown: Rockets beat Midshipmen 72-51 at Baha Mar Convention Center in Nassau, Bahamas. Rockets led 26-21 at the half and never looked back. The 4th quarter decided it: Rockets won it 25-16.
Leading the way — Rockets: Evalyse Cole 19 pts; Reagan Wilson 3 ast; Jyah LoVett 7 reb. Midshipmen: Julianna Almeida 13 pts; Zanai Barnett-Gay 4 ast, 5 reb.
Where Rockets won it: they shot 48% to 35%, shot 29% from three to 23% and won the boards 40-25.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 23, 10:57 AM ET. It had Rockets 65% and Midshipmen 35%, projecting Rockets 70 – Midshipmen 65.2 (135.1 total, Rockets by 4.8).

Final: Rockets 72 – Midshipmen 51. Right winner: it had Rockets at 65%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Rockets came in with a league-average attack and a 6% stingier than average defense (3-2, 64 scored and 62.4 allowed a game over 5 games), worth about 162 and 161 games of evidence. Projected to score 70, they scored 72 (+2 points, 3% over); projected to allow 65.2, they allowed 51 (−14.2 points, 22% under).

Midshipmen came in with a 2% above average attack and a 2% leakier than average defense (4-2, 78 scored and 70.2 allowed a game over 6 games), worth about 162 and 161 games of evidence. Projected to score 65.2, they scored 51 (−14.2 points, 22% under); projected to allow 70, they allowed 72 (+2 points, 3% over).

The bigger miss was Midshipmen's scoring (-14.2 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 123 against 135.1 projected (-12.1), about the 19th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±14).

Margin: Rockets by 21 against Rockets by 4.8 projected, about the 11th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±13).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body: Splits (Action Network): total: 80% of bets on the over, 74% of the money; moneyline: 91% of bets on Rockets, 85% of the money.

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin; there were no odds to check the projection against.

The result was off its normal range without being an outlier, so the flags may have played a part.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.885 of the raw projection. It counts toward NCAAW scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 953 graded NCAAW games the algo now scales scoring ×0.972 and gives home teams +1.3 points. Team corrections so far: Rockets attack ×1.007, defense ×0.987 (5 games); Midshipmen attack ×1.010, defense ×1.016 (6 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 16.2 points), no bet.
